releaseNotesMarkdown:
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mveinot/transmission-control/compare/v2.0.1.380...v2.1.0.396

Notable changes:

* Build against Qt 6.11.2
* Icon and colour theme support - user defined themes are supported

User-defined themes are searched for in `~/Library/Application Support/mvgrafx/Planetary/icon-themes`

A sample pack will be available to download on the project website: https://planetary.mvgrafx.net
